create_function_long_answer: create a function that uses sgl.gen with min_tokens=64 to enforce a longer answer
create_function_short_answer: create a function that uses sgl.gen without min_tokens for a short answer
run_runtime_backend: run a sglang Runtime backend with meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model
run_function_state: run a sgl.function and retrieve the answer from the state dictionary
shutdown_runtime: shutdown the sglang Runtime backend after running functions
